scripts.build: npm run clean; npm run build:copy; rollup --config
scripts.build:copy: mkdir -p dist && cp -Rp src/index.html src/assets dist
scripts.deploy:services: rsync --archive --del --info=stats --exclude .git --exclude .github --exclude .venv --exclude __pycache__ --exclude .entrecote services/ -- rss-box:services-update/ && ssh rss-box deploy-services
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && rsync --archive --del --exclude .ssh --info=stats dist/ -- rss-box:/
scripts.install: npm run install:server; npm run install:local; npm run install:environment
scripts.install:environment: if [ ! -e src/environment.js ]; then echo 'export const urls = {};' > src/environment.js; fi
scripts.install:local: if [ ! -e src/local.js ]; then echo 'export const urls = {};' > src/local.js; fi
scripts.install:server: git submodule init; git submodule update; (cd services; make install)
scripts.release: npm version --no-git-tag $v; npm run build; git commit --all --message 'Rebuild dist files'; npm version --allow-same-version $v
scripts.roxy: python -c "import sys, os; os.system('curl --head http://localhost:8000/roxy?url=%s' % sys.argv[1])"
